title: Founder's Course at Verrado Golf Club
specs: Two 18-hole championship golf courses designed by Tom Lehman and John Fought
Victory Course uses natural rocky terrain and offers strategic holes
All golfers must have a set of clubs; rental clubs available for $75 plus tax including 2 sleeves of balls

Appropriate attire required: Men collared or mocked neck shirt, Bermuda shorts minimum 6' inseam; Women collared or golf blouse with medium length shorts, skirt or slacks; no denim, T-shirts, cut-offs, mesh shirts, swim suits, sweat clothes
Spectator carts allowed based on availability; fee $30 May-Oct, $50 Nov-Apr

options.name: Par Pass Couples Annual Membership (Renewal Only)

includes: Discounts in golf shop and restaurants
gap: Duration of a round not stated
blurb: Guests play golf on the Founders Course or Victory Course, both 18-hole championship courses designed by Tom Lehman and John Fought. The club offers various annual pass programs and a GOLFvantage membership for discounted play and benefits. Facilities include a golf shop, dining options, and practice facilities.
tags: Par Pass Couples Annual Membership (Renewal Only)
